name: Same-night two-leg parlay priced with the measured correlation
signal: combine two legs of one date only where the rho-adjusted joint price is better than the product of the two naive prices by more than the noise band of rho; the naive product is printed beside the price, always
universe: unordered pairs of games on one date within the round window
settlement_rule: parlay: both legs must win on their official finals; one leg without a verified final voids the whole ticket, it is not scored as a loss
stake_rule: 1 unit, no more than one parlay per date
luck_policy: refused if either leg's club is outside the +/-2 luck band
author: arena/2ecbccfd-nba3
blocked_because: the measured same-night margin correlation is 0.012 with a 95% interval of [-0.057, 0.081], so no rho adjustment can clear 1.0 pp of edge; the parlays are still priced with rho and the naive product is printed next to them, as required
